lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's fifty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 50? Nope!

lines.text: Twenty times n is a perfect square. Fifty times n is a perfect cube.
lines.caption: 20 times n is a perfect square. 50 times n is a perfect cube.

lines.text: Twenty is two times two times five. Fifty is two times five times five.
lines.caption: 20 is 2 × 2 × 5. 50 is 2 × 5 × 5.

lines.text: Squares need even counts. Cubes need multiples of three.
lines.caption: Squares need even counts. Cubes need multiples of 3.

lines.text: Add twos. One fails both, but two work for both!
lines.caption: Add twos. One fails both, but two work for both!

lines.text: For the fives, just one fixes both!
lines.caption: For the fives, just one fixes both!

lines.text: So n is two times two times five. That's twenty!
lines.caption: So n is 2 × 2 × 5. That's 20!

lines.text: Fifty was the trap. It makes a cube, but not a square.
lines.caption: 50 was the trap. It makes a cube, but not a square.

lines.text: Did you get twenty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 20? Tell me below!
